title: 第十七章 亡者证词第十八章 铁柱算账
slug: 坟头开铺我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
lines: 梁家祠堂前，连风都停了。
梁正德亡魂悬在棺上，魂身很淡。被反向镇魂符锁了半年，他说每一个字都像在磨魂。
沈清萝没有催。
她先让梁氏退到灯影外。
生人情绪太重，会扯亡魂念头。梁氏若一直哭，梁正德很容易只顾着看她，忘了最该说的事。
梁氏也懂，咬着帕子往后退。
沈清萝这才开口。
“梁正德，按顺序说。先银账，再药，再春桃。别急着骂人，骂人不能入卷。”
梁正德怔了一下。
阿青在旁边小声：“死人刚醒就被你安排得明明白白。”
沈清萝道：“他若想骂，等入卷后慢慢骂。”
梁正德看着她，缓慢点头。
“去年冬月，我查铺子账。三千两修坟银，没有进石坊。二弟说生意亏空，我查到银子去了清虚观外门。”
铁柱翻开井中半本账册。纸页被烧得卷曲，他用短短的手指压着边角，像压着一条还想逃的蛇。
“对得上。”
他说完，又补了一句：“日期也对得上。”
沈清萝点头。
亡魂说话，账本落地。一个是阴证，一个是阳证。阴阳两头都合，梁二叔再想说是鬼话，就没那么容易了。
梁正德继续道：“我追问他。他说梁家气运衰了，祖坟要改。清虚观的人能替梁家换三年财运。我不肯。他便让我别管。”
梁二叔怒道：“大哥，你死后怨气太重，被邪祟迷了心智！”
梁正德看向他。
“我死前，你也是这么说。”
梁二叔脸色一僵。
沈清萝没有让他继续插话。
她把梁正德说出的银数、账页、日期一一重复给铁柱确认。铁柱每点一次头，梁家族老的脸色就难看一分。
这是问魂，也是当众对账。
沈清萝不替他润色。亡魂说得慢，她就等；账本翻得慢，她也等。越慢，越像一把钝刀，一下一下刮在梁二叔脸上。
他只要说错一句，梁二叔就能翻身。可他没有错。
沈清萝问：“药呢？”
梁正德的魂影颤了颤。
“我弟弟给我的最后一碗药，是甜的。”
梁氏猛地捂住嘴。
梁正德声音更哑。
“我那时还以为，他终于肯对我好。”
祠堂里没人说话。
这句话比“毒杀”更重。
梁氏眼泪滚下来，却没出声。
她忽然想起那碗药。正德从前最怕苦，那日药味不苦，他还笑了一下，说难得二弟记得。
原来不是记得。
content_en:
In front of the Liang family ancestral hall, even the wind stopped.
The soul of Liang Zhengde hangs on the coffin, and his body is very faint. Being locked up by the reverse soul-suppressing talisman for half a year, every word he spoke was like grinding his soul.
Shen Qingluo didn't rush.
She first asked Liang to retreat outside the lamp shadow.
If a stranger is too emotional, he will have thoughts of the dead. If Mrs. Liang keeps crying, Liang Zhengde will easily just look at her and forget the most important thing to say.
Mrs. Liang also understood, biting the handkerchief and stepped back.
Only then did Shen Qingluo speak.
"Liang Zhengde, let's talk in order. First the bank account, then the medicine, and then the spring peach. Don't be in a hurry to curse, as swearing will not be included in the case."
Liang Zhengde was startled.
Ah Qing whispered from the side: "You have clearly arranged the dead man's life as soon as he woke up."
Shen Qingluo said: "If he wants to scold him, he can do it slowly after he enters the paper."
Liang Zhengde looked at her and nodded slowly.
"Last winter, I checked the shop's account. Three thousand taels of silver were found for repairing graves, but they didn't go into the stone workshop. My second brother said that the business was losing money, so I found the money and went to the outer gate of Qingxu Temple."
Tie Zhu opened half of the account books in the well. The paper was curled by the heat, and he pressed the corners with his short fingers, like a snake still trying to escape.
"That's right."
After he finished speaking, he added: "The date is also right."
Shen Qingluo nodded.
The dead soul spoke and the ledger fell to the ground. One is a yin syndrome and the other is a yang syndrome. Both ends of yin and yang are in harmony, and it will not be so easy for Uncle Liang to tell lies again.
Liang Zhengde continued: "I asked him. He said that the Liang family's fortune had declined and that the ancestral graves needed to be renovated. People with Qingxu Guan could change the Liang family's fortune for three years. I refused. He told me to leave it alone."
Second Uncle Liang said angrily: "Brother, you were too resentful after your death and were possessed by evil spirits!"
Liang Zhengde looked at him.
"You said the same thing before I died."
Uncle Liang's face froze.
Shen Qingluo didn't let him continue to interrupt.
She repeated the amount of money, account pages, and dates mentioned by Liang Zhengde to Tie Zhu for confirmation. Every time Tie Zhu nodded, the face of the Liang family elder became uglier.
This is soul questioning and reconciliation in public.
Shen Qingluo didn't polish it for him. If the soul of the deceased is slow to speak, she will wait; if the ledger is slow to turn over, she will also wait. The slower it goes, the more it looks like a dull knife, scratching Uncle Liang's face again and again.
As long as he says one wrong thing, Uncle Liang can turn over. But he wasn't wrong.
Shen Qingluo asked: "Where is the medicine?"
Liang Zhengde's soul trembled.
"The last bowl of medicine my brother gave me was sweet."
Mrs. Liang suddenly covered her mouth.
Liang Zhengde's voice became hoarse.
"I thought at that time that he was finally willing to be nice to me."
No one spoke in the ancestral hall.
This sentence is more serious than "poison".
Mrs. Liang's tears rolled down her face, but she didn't make a sound.
She suddenly remembered the bowl of medicine. Zhengde used to be afraid of bitterness, but the medicine didn't taste bitter that day. He even smiled and said that it was rare for his second brother to remember it.
It turns out I didn’t remember it.
